# 深度学习生成的《我的世界》地图对比图谱

## 总览：生成模型与特征对应关系
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GM5_2["gm5.2"]
    GBT["GBT"]
    DeepSC["DeepSC"]

    Sun["太阳"]
    Night["夜晚"]
    Stars["星星"]
    Textures["纹理质量"]
    Animation["动画效果"]
    Breakable["可破坏方块"]
    Expand["地图可扩展"]
    ModelQuality["模型完整度"]

    GM5_2 -->|有| Sun
    GM5_2 -->|有| Night
    GM5_2 -->|有| Stars
    GM5_2 -->|高| Textures
    GM5_2 -->|缺失| Animation
    GM5_2 -->|缺失| Breakable
    GM5_2 -->|有| Expand
    GM5_2 -->|高| ModelQuality

    GBT -->|有| Sun
    GBT -->|有| Night
    GBT -->|少| Stars
    GBT -->|中| Textures
    GBT -->|缺失| Animation
    GBT -->|有| Breakable
    GBT -->|有| Expand
    GBT -->|中| ModelQuality

    DeepSC -->|有| Sun
    DeepSC -->|有| Night
    DeepSC -->|有| Stars
    DeepSC -->|中| Textures
    DeepSC -->|缺失| Animation
    DeepSC -->|有| Breakable
    DeepSC -->|有| Expand
    DeepSC -->|中| ModelQuality
```

## 优缺点对照
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GM5_2["gm5.2"]
    GBT["GBT"]
    DeepSC["DeepSC"]

    GoodTex["纹理好"]
    GoodComp["完成度高"]
    GoodSun["太阳表现佳"]
    NoBreakGrass["草方块不可破"]
    NoAnim["无动画"]
    ModelIssue["模型局部缺陷"]

    GM5_2 --> GoodTex
    GM5_2 --> GoodComp
    GM5_2 --> GoodSun
    GM5_2 --> NoBreakGrass
    GM5_2 --> NoAnim
    GM5_2 --> ModelIssue

    GBT --> GoodComp
    GBT --> GoodSun
    GBT --> NoAnim
    GBT --> NoBreakGrass
    GBT --> ModelIssue

    DeepSC --> GoodComp
    DeepSC --> NoAnim
    DeepSC --> ModelIssue
```

## 生成流程与关键环节
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Prompt["提示词 (Prompt)"]
    ModelSelect["模型选择"]
    Generation["世界生成"]
    TextureAdj["纹理调整"]
    AnimCheck["动画检查"]
    ExpandOpt["扩展地图选项"]
    PostProcess["后处理"]
    Result["生成的地图 (Result)"]

    Prompt --> ModelSelect
    ModelSelect --> Generation
    Generation --> TextureAdj
    TextureAdj --> AnimCheck
    AnimCheck --> ExpandOpt
    ExpandOpt --> PostProcess
    PostProcess --> Result
```
